page.layout: One printed page (p. 67) with one column of running text. Margin notes stand in the right margin, beside lines 22–30. Below the text: signature "Ee 2" at centre and catchword at the right. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: quasi spiritualem facem introducere, qua divinam lucem animus concipit & calorem, quo caelitus inardescat. Luc. XXIV. 32. Rident ista Remonstrantes, & quot-quot conversionem ex nobis, solo verbo adjutis, derivant, non ex Deo & singulari operatione Spiritus: sed male. Episcopius, in judicio de controversia Anabaptistarum, de ordinario medio conversionis Oper. Part. II. Calvinisticum dicit pag. 375. statuere quod homo sit ineptus ad sensum verbi intellectu capiendum, & propterea peculiarem etiam internam inspirationem & operationem Dei accedere oportere, quae hominem ad id idoneum reddat & in hominis intellectu & voluntate sensum illum efficaciter exprimat, infundat aut inspiret. adde pag. 372. & paulo post ait Hoornbeek. Auctor & causa illumina-tionis, quemadmodum jam indicavimus, solus est Deus Ps. cxix. 8. Jes. L. 4. 5. per Verbum Act. xxvi. 17. 18. Rom. I. 17. x. 15. Eph. iii. 9. 2. Tim. i. 19. 2. Cor. iv. 4. &c. & per Spiritum Joh. xvi. 13. Eph. i. 17. Hebr. vi. 4. etenim ab eo solo est veritas credenda; & NB lumen internum, quo videri ac percipi illa potest. 1. Tim. iii. 16. imo talis est illuminatio, ut non solis gradibus, sed, contrarium licet docente Velthuisen, De usu Rat. p.8. tota specie differat ab ea quae unquam est in non electis, in reprobis. Elevari possunt, sic Tuissus, potentiae naturales ad objectum aliquod supernaturale per habitus quosdam supernaturales, verum potentiarum novarum, quae ipsis inhaerant, capaces omnino non sunt. Habitus supernaturalis intellectum afficiens habet se per modum luminis supernaturalis. Hos autem habitus supernaturales vereor ut admittant adversarii. Splendide & magnificè quidem de ea loquuntur, imo non minori apparatu, quam ipse Wolzogius, eo tamen non contentus Subtilissimus disputator, sic pergit, Gratiam istam supernaturalem quam praedicant, & supra Paradisum efferunt, negant haberi per modum NB infusionis, ut ante hac accepimus ex Arminio, suffragante Cor-

page.notes: Layout: the margin notes sit right of the column; their placement in the paragraph follows the printed line where each note stands. Italic and roman setting was judged from a small scan: names and numerals are treated as roman, the rest as italic, and the exact type in lines 7–9 and 22–23 may differ. The catchword "vino" is followed by a mark (ȝ or ;) that is unclear; read as "vino;" with [?]. The swash letters before "Auctor", "Anabaptistarum" and "Arminio" are printer's ornaments, not separate letters. The reference "Luc. XXIV. 32." and the other citations are copied as printed. The left edge shows faint show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed.
